tei:div.tei:p: "$ (619)༄༅// thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma bzhugs so/// /

(620)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam 'debs par 'dod na/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis phyogs bcu nas bskor ba gsal btab te/ 'di skad ces brjod do// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gcig tu 'dus pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa yab sras 'phags tshogs rab 'byams dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos po thams cad kyi mchod pas mnyes par bgyi'o// nyes byas thams cad so sor bshags so// dge ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus par bskor bar bskul lo// mya ngan mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// yang dag par skyabs su mchi lags so// khyod kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i slad du sems bskyed do// thabs (621)dang spyod pa dang*// rmad du byung ba'i lam brten par bgyi'o// dge ba bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dge ba dus gsum du byed pa dang*// byed par 'gyur ba dang*// byas pa'i dge ba bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rangs shig bsngags pa brjod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi mthu las// bdag dang sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa/ brton pa bzhi ldan chen po dol po pa/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po khyod kyi bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /nyid kyi lta spyod dang grub mtha' bzang po 'dzin cing dgongs pa skyong ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa shin tu mang pos sa steng (622)khyab par gyur cig

/de dag gi 'phrin las rnam par dkar ba gong nas gong du rgyas shing*/ de lta bu la bar du gcod pa cung zad kyang mi 'byung bar gyur cig /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyang tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan thams cad du/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po khyed kyi phrin las sgrub pa dang*// gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin par gyur cig /sku'i snang ba dang mi 'bral zhing*/ thugs kyi bzhed pa thams cad sgrub par gyur cig /ma dad pa dang log lta skad cig kyang mi skye zhing*/ mos gus drag po dad pa brtan pos/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas khyed kyi bsngags pa dang*// bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho phyogs kun du brjod par gyur cig /nyid kyi bstan pa dang*/ de 'dzin pa'i skyes chen la ma dad pa'i skye bo rnams dad pa la 'dzud par gyur cig /mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ lha dang 'byung po mthu bo che thams cad kyis kyang kun mkhyen brton pa bzhi ldan khyod kyi bstan pa rgyas par byed cing gus pas mchod par gyur cig /de ltar khyod kyi bstan pa la dang ba'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang*/ 'byor ba dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ stobs dang*/ gzig brjid phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don bzang po thams cad gegs med par 'grub par gyur cig /skye ba kun du rgyal ba jo nang pa chen po khyod kyi rnam thar bzang por 'jug par gyur cig /thugs dgyes pa'i thabs kho na sgrub par gyur cig /dgongs pa skyong ba'i chos kyi sgras phas rgol thams cad zil gyis gnon par gyur cig /khyod kyi bstan pa la sdang ba dang gnod par byed pa thams cad/ gang la gang 'dul gyi thabs sna tshogs kyis btul nas khyod kyi bstan pa la 'god par gyur cig /ma dar ba (623)rnams su dar bar byed cing*/ dar ba rnams dag cing 'phel ba dang*/ nyams pa rnams su gso nus par gyur cig /lus dang longs spyod dang srog las kyang khyod kyi bstan pa gces spras su 'dzin par gyur cig

/rnam par dag pa'i rigs sam/ rnam par dag pa'i khams bde gshegs snying po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gdod ma nas grub pa'i don khong du chud par gyur cig /sangs rgyas rtag pa dang*/ chos bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun mi bslu ba'i don la nges pa rnyed par gyur cig /kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gyi chos med bzhin du snang ba/ sgyu ma lta bu'i don rtogs par gyur cig /don dam spros bral rtag rab brtan zhing g.yu drung gi gnas mngon du byang bar gyur cig /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las brtsam ste/ tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje bzhi dang*/ sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /gnas skabs thams cad du rigs ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku dol po ba chen po chos rje yab sras rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zhal gyi bdud rtsi nges don mthar thug gi grub mtha' la brten nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung ma lus pa la 'jug par gyur cig /gzhan yang de rnams kyang yang dag pa'i chos 'di nyid kho na la 'jug par gyur cig /'jig rten mgon po'i rnam 'phrul jo nang pa chos rje yab sras rnams kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ste 'bral med du bstan par gyur cig /theg pa mtha' dag la mkhas shing*/ gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta ba 'bral med du skyong bar gyur cig /dam tshig dang ldan pas rim gnyis mtha' dag rnal 'byor du byed cing*/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi snying po can du gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mthar phyin cing gzhan don phyogs med (624)du nus par gyur cig /rgyal po la sogs pa gtso bo thams cad chos bzhin du chos kyis dbang du 'dus nas mchog gi dge ba lam bzang 'di la 'god par gyur cig /khyed kyi bstan pa rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dbyings su zhi bar gyur cig /rnyed pa dang bkur bsti la sogs pa phan 'dogs pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par gyur cig

/'khor 'das srid gsum gyi las dang bya byed yin no cog thams cad khyod kyi bstan par gus pa dang*/ dar ba dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /phun tshogs thar pa'i lam gyi gzhir gyur pa// rtag chad mtha' spangs zab mo dbu ma'i lam// spros bral bde gshegs snying po'i don ston pa'i// nges don bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po jo nang ba'i// bstan pa yul rnams kun du khyab pa dang*// phyogs rnams kun du nam yang mi nub cing*// dus rnams kun du 'phel zhing dar bar shog /mdo don mthar thug gzhan stong dbu ma dang*// rgyud don mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis// lta sgom 'brel pas lam gyi gnad bzung nas// chos sgo mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa shog /brton pa bzhi ldan gang de'i bstan pa la// phan par sgrub cing bya ba byed pa kun// tshe ring nad med 'byor pa rgyas pa dang*// dbang phyug dam pa thob cing gegs med shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i// bstan pa bsrung zhing bstan la dga' ba yi// chos skyong lha dang 'byung po'i tshogs kun kyang*// mthu stobs rgyas shing 'jig rten skyong bar shog /brgyud ldan bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i nus mthu dang*// (625)mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i mthu stobs kyis// smon lam 'di btab ji bzhin 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang*// lung rtogs bzhi lam 'bras bu'i dam chos dang*// theg gsum lam la gnas pa'i 'phags tshogs te// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// smon lam 'di yang gegs med 'grub par shog /don dam chos nyid gdod nas dag pa dang*// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa dang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang rdzas kyi bden pa yis// de ltar smon lam btab pa 'grub par shog

/de ltar rgyal mchog sras dang slob mar bcas// bstan bsrung lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin dang*// dkar phyogs skyong ba mthu ldan thams cad kyis// 'dir btab smon lam 'grub par mdzad du gsol// skyabs gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i dge legs dang*// don dam rtag brtan bden pa'i phun tshogs kyis// nges don bstan pa'i bdag po jo nang pa'i// 'phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam zab mo 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas dpal gyi gnas mchog chos 'khor lha sar sbyar ba'o// gang zhig smon lam 'di 'debs par byed pa de yang tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ chos dang thar pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs par gyur ro/// /bkra shis/
